# zimaos Provider

Manage a ZimaOS device via its OpenAPI (App Management, Local Storage, Users, System).

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    zimaos = {
      source = "brian-guerrero/zimaos"
    }
  }
}

# Preferred: username + password. Tokens are short-lived, so the provider
# exchanges credentials for a fresh one via POST /login on each run instead
# of relying on a token you'd otherwise have to keep pasting in.
provider "zimaos" {
  host     = "http://192.168.1.50:8080"
  username = var.zimaos_username
  password = var.zimaos_password
}

# Alternative: a pre-obtained API token instead of username/password.
# provider "zimaos" {
#   host  = "http://192.168.1.50:8080"
#   token = var.zimaos_token
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `host` (String) Base URL of the ZimaOS device API, e.g. http://192.168.1.50:8080

### Optional

- `password` (String, Sensitive) ZimaOS password. Used with username to obtain a token via POST /login when token is not set.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) API access token sent as a bare 'Authorization' header (no 'Bearer ' prefix — confirmed against a live device, see internal/client/client.go). Optional: if omitted, username+password are exchanged for a token via POST /login (tokens are short-lived, so this is the preferred way to avoid stale tokens).
- `username` (String, Sensitive) ZimaOS username. Used with password to obtain a token via POST /login when token is not set.
